# VFX-JS

> VFX-JS is a JavaScript library that adds WebGL shader effects to HTML elements (images, videos, text, any element) and animates tab, carousel and page transitions. Packages: `@vfx-js/core` (the `VFX` class), `@vfx-js/react` (React, Next.js, React Router), `@vfx-js/vue` (Vue, Nuxt, Vue Router), `@vfx-js/svelte` (Svelte 5, SvelteKit), `@vfx-js/astro` (Astro, ClientRouter), `@vfx-js/effects` (prebuilt effects), `@vfx-js/transitions` (transition presets).

Quick start:

```ts
import { VFX } from "@vfx-js/core";

const vfx = new VFX();
await vfx.add(document.querySelector("img")!, { shader: "glitch", overflow: 100 });
```

VFX-JS runs in the browser only and needs WebGL. Create the `VFX` instance in client code and reuse one instance per page.

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fand/vfx-js/main/skills/vfx-js/SKILL.md): packages, presets, options, React, pitfalls
- [Custom shaders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fand/vfx-js/main/skills/vfx-js/references/shader.md): GLSL template, built-in uniforms, overflow, multipass, post effects
- [Effects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fand/vfx-js/main/skills/vfx-js/references/effects.md): prebuilt effects and the Effect API
- [Transitions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fand/vfx-js/main/skills/vfx-js/references/transitions.md): `addTransition`, presets, custom transitions, React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt and SvelteKit
